import { Header } from "@/components/layout/Headers/header2" import { Footer } from "@/components/layout/landing/components/footer" import { Shield, Eye, Lock, Settings, Users, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react" export default function PrivacyPage() { return (
{/* Hero */}

Privacy Policy

We respect your privacy and treat your data with care.

{/* Intro */}

At Milestis, we believe your memories belong to you. This policy explains what information we collect, why we need it, and how we keep it safe. We've written this in plain language because we want you to understand exactly how your data is handled.

{/* Sections */}
{/* Section 1 */}

Information we collect

When you use Milestis, we collect:

  • Your email address for account access
  • Basic account information you provide
  • Photos and content you choose to upload

We only collect what's necessary to make Milestis work for you.

{/* Section 2 */}

How we use your data

We use your information to:

  • Let you sign in and access your account
  • Save and display your memory book projects
  • Improve Milestis based on how people use it
  • Send important updates about your account
{/* Section 3 */}

Photos and personal content

Your photos and memories are precious. Here's how we treat them:

  • You own everything you upload — always
  • Your content is private by default
  • We never sell or share your photos with anyone
  • Only you decide who can see your memory books

Your memories stay yours. We're just here to help you preserve them beautifully.

{/* Section 4 */}

Third-party services

To make Milestis work smoothly, we use a few trusted services:

  • Secure authentication providers (like Google sign-in)
  • Reliable hosting to keep your data safe
  • Basic analytics to understand how to improve

These services are carefully chosen and follow strict privacy standards.

{/* Section 5 */}

Your control

You're always in control of your data:

  • Edit or delete your content anytime
  • Download your photos and projects
  • Request complete account removal
  • Ask us questions about your data
{/* Section 6 */}

Updates to this policy

If we make meaningful changes to this policy, we'll let you know through email or a notice in the app. We won't surprise you with sudden changes to how your data is handled.

{/* Footer note */}

If you have questions, feel free to{" "} contact us .

{/* Hero */}

Terms of Service

Simple rules to keep Milestis safe and enjoyable for everyone.

{/* Intro */}

By using Milestis, you agree to follow a few basic guidelines. We've written these in human language — no confusing legal terms. These rules help us create a safe, respectful space for everyone to preserve their memories.

{/* Sections */}
{/* Section 1 */}

Using Milestis

Milestis is designed for:

  • Personal memory books and photo stories
  • Professional work for clients (photographers, event planners)
  • Sharing special moments with family and friends

Please don't use Milestis for anything harmful, illegal, or that could hurt others. We want this to be a positive space for everyone.

{/* Section 2 */}

Your content

When you upload photos and create memory books:

  • You keep full ownership of everything you create
  • You're responsible for having the right to use what you upload
  • Please respect others' privacy in photos you share

Your memories, your rules. We just provide the tools to make them beautiful.

{/* Section 3 */}

Your account

A few simple rules about accounts:

  • One account per person is plenty
  • Keep your login details safe and private
  • Let us know if you notice any unusual activity
{/* Section 4 */}

Paid features

If you choose to use paid features:

  • Prices are shown clearly before you pay
  • No hidden fees or surprise charges
  • Cancel anytime — your free features remain available

We believe in being upfront about costs. What you see is what you pay.

{/* Section 5 */}

Service availability

We work hard to keep Milestis running smoothly, but we want to be honest:

  • Sometimes we need to update or improve things
  • Features may change as we make Milestis better
  • Occasional maintenance is necessary

We'll always try to give you notice when possible.

{/* Section 6 */}

Ending your account

You're free to leave whenever you want:

  • Delete your account at any time
  • Download your content before you go
  • No hard feelings — we hope you come back

We may also remove accounts that seriously violate these guidelines, but we'll always try to reach out first.

{/* Section 7 */}

Changes to these terms

If we update these terms, we'll let you know in advance. We won't surprise you with major changes — you'll always have time to review what's new before continuing to use Milestis.

{/* Footer note */}

These terms exist to protect both you and Milestis.
If something isn't clear, just{" "} ask us .

) }
